description: Queensland water and sewerage service provider key performance indicator data is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Local Government, Water and Volunteers. An open dataset of key performance indicator (KPI) data from relevant service providers in Queensland. Relevant service providers include drinking water service providers who provide water and sewerage services. The dataset contains KPIs related to customer service, water security, and financial sustainability. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Local Government, Water and Volunteers. Its tags are indicator, kpi, performance, service provider, sewerage. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2026-06-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
